# MA Foods Stuff — mahesh-appaso-foodstuff.vercel.app

Dubai-based trader (Mahesh Appaso Foodstuff Trading L.L.C, TRN 105507496500003)
of Indian Basmati & non-Basmati rice and pulses to wholesale buyers worldwide.
